classification.difficultyReason: Interpret unions, intersections and complements as regions in overlapping two-set Venn diagrams.

content.prompt: Shade the Venn diagrams with the set.

spec.description: Blank overlapping two-set Venn diagram in a rectangular universal set.
spec.mathematics: A is the left circle; B is the right circle.

answer.short: Shade all of $A$, including the overlap.
answer.worked: The set $A$ includes both the $A$-only region and $A\cap B$. Shade the entire left circle.

spec.mathematics: A, including its intersection with B.

spec.description: Blank overlapping two-set Venn diagram in a rectangular universal set.
spec.mathematics: A is the left circle; B is the right circle.

answer.short: Shade all of $B$, including the overlap.
answer.worked: The set $B$ includes both the $B$-only region and $A\cap B$. Shade the entire right circle.

spec.mathematics: B, including its intersection with A.

spec.description: Blank overlapping two-set Venn diagram in a rectangular universal set.
spec.mathematics: A is the left circle; B is the right circle.

answer.worked: $A\cap B$ contains elements in both sets. Shade only the region common to the two circles.

spec.description: Blank overlapping two-set Venn diagram in a rectangular universal set.
spec.mathematics: A is the left circle; B is the right circle.

answer.short: Shade both circles, including the overlap.
answer.worked: $A\cup B$ contains elements in $A$ or $B$ or both. Shade the entire area inside either circle.

spec.description: Both circles shaded, including their overlap.
Blank overlapping two-set Venn diagram in a rectangular universal set.
spec.mathematics: A is the left circle; B is the right circle.

answer.worked: $A\cap\overline{B}$ contains elements in $A$ but not in $B$. Shade the left circle outside the overlap.

spec.description: Left circle shaded with a white mask excluding B.
Blank overlapping two-set Venn diagram in a rectangular universal set.
spec.mathematics: A is the left circle; B is the right circle.

answer.worked: $\overline{A}\cap B$ contains elements in $B$ but not in $A$. Shade the right circle outside the overlap.

spec.description: Right circle shaded with a white mask excluding A.
Blank overlapping two-set Venn diagram in a rectangular universal set.
spec.mathematics: A is the left circle; B is the right circle.

answer.worked: $\overline{A}$ contains all elements of the universal set that are not in $A$. Shade the $B$-only region and the region outside both circles.

spec.description: Universal-set rectangle shaded except for the entire left circle.
spec.mathematics: Complement of A relative to xi.

spec.description: Blank overlapping two-set Venn diagram in a rectangular universal set.
spec.mathematics: A is the left circle; B is the right circle.

answer.short: Shade the region outside both circles.
answer.worked: $\overline{A}\cap\overline{B}$ contains elements that are in neither $A$ nor $B$. Shade only the area inside $\xi$ and outside both circles.

spec.description: Universal-set rectangle shaded with both circles masked white.
spec.mathematics: Intersection of the complements of A and B.
